No application was launched and no performance benchmark was run.

problem: No reproducible distribution defect with a tested fix was identified. Existing desktop appearance differs from the older textual preference and was preserved for local review. Integrity-check qualifications were investigated without changing permissions or the customized launcher.
solution: Retained existing installed configuration after read-only verification; no corrective system change was justified by the collected evidence.
